turn.content: PO price for line 1 is 129,200; the invoice bills 137,000. The only addendum in the contract (clause 11.1) concerns a *different* item (Cairan Pembersih Lantai, effective 9 Oct 2026) — no clause supports a higher price for Sabun Cuci Tangan. Contract 2.1 says prices are fixed.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0043", "detail": "Line 1 'Sabun Cuci Tangan 5L' ordered at unit price 129200; invoice bills 137000 (18 x 137000 = 2466000)."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-003#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices in Lampiran A remain fixed for the term of the agreement."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-003#2.2", "detail": "Price changes only via a signed written addendum and are not retroactive."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-003#11.1", "detail": "The only addendum raises the price of Cairan Pembersih Lantai 5L from 9 October 2026 — not this item, and after the invoice date 2026-09-22."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "0582/INV/BSJ/IX/2026", "detail": "Invoice date 2026-09-22 bills line 1 at 137000."}], "explanation": "The invoiced unit price of 137000 exceeds the PO price of 129200 for Sabun Cuci Tangan 5L, and no contract clause or addendum allows a price increase for this item, so the difference is an overcharge of 7800 per unit (140400 on the line)."}]}
